hero.subtitle: Your keyboard ⌨️ has been waiting its whole life for this moment. Drill the home row until your fingers find the keys in their sleep 😴, smoke the speed test ⚡, dodge the word rain ☔, and zoom past your friends in a real-time race 🏁. Sound effects included 🔊, smirks optional 😏. No account, no excuses — just you, a keyboard, and the sound of speed 🚀.

features.title: Everything you need to learn typing
features.subtitle: A focused set of tools built around one idea: practice, get measured, improve.
features.fingerDesc: Progressive lessons that teach the home row, top row and bottom row with clear finger hints.
features.englishDesc: Words, sentences and short paragraphs to build rhythm and muscle memory.
features.speedDesc: Timed 15 / 30 / 60-second rounds with WPM, accuracy and consistency charts.
features.statsDesc: Every session is saved on your device so you can watch yourself improve.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: Pick a course and start with the first lesson.

practice.numpadHint: Use the numeric keypad — the top row won't register.
practice.spaceAutoHint: Spaces are added automatically — just type the letters.
practice.locked: This lesson is locked — complete the previous one to unlock it.
practice.unlockNext: Go to the next unlocked lesson
practice.retryHint: Meet all three bars to unlock the next lesson.

speed.title: Speed Test
speed.subtitle: Type as much as you can before the clock runs out.
speed.customPlaceholder: Paste or type your own text for the test…
speed.unlockHint: Skip challenge: reach over {{wpm}} WPM (English) or {{cpm}} chars/min (Chinese) to unlock lessons up to "{{lesson}}".
speed.unlockPassed: Speed unlocked — every lesson up to "{{lesson}}" is now open!
speed.unlockFailed: Not fast enough yet — you need over {{wpm}} WPM or {{cpm}} chars/min.

stats.title: My Stats
stats.subtitle: Your practice history, stored on this device only.
stats.empty: No sessions yet — go take a lesson or a speed test.
stats.weakKeysEmpty: No mistakes recorded yet — keep typing and we'll show which keys trip you up.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.subtitle: Unlock badges as you practice — it all stays on your device.

vimTerminal.title: Interactive Vim terminal
vimTerminal.subtitle: A sandboxed Vim where every keystroke is real. Move with hjkl, edit with dd / ciw / p, undo with u, search with /, and try :w or :q.

custom.title: Custom text
custom.subtitle: Paste your own text and practice it — great for speeches, lyrics or anything you're about to type for real.
custom.placeholder: Paste or type the text you want to practice here…

game.title: Word Rain
game.subtitle: Type the falling words before they hit the ground. Speed up, level up, don't get drenched.
game.howto: Words are falling — type each one to zap it. Missing a word costs a life.
game.pauseHint: Press Esc or the button to resume

settings.title: Settings
settings.heading: Settings
settings.subtitle: Tune the look and feel to your liking — everything stays on this device.

onboarding.subtitle: Set your preferences before you start — you can change them anytime in Settings.

auth.title: Account
auth.notConfigured: Supabase isn't configured yet. To enable sign-in and multiplayer, create a Supabase project and fill in your credentials.
auth.notConfiguredHint: See .env.example and supabase/schema.sql for the setup steps.
auth.usernameInvalid: Username must be 3–20 letters, digits or underscores.
auth.validation: Enter a valid username and a password of at least 6 characters.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.rateLimit: Too many attempts — wait about an hour. Also make sure "Confirm email" is turned OFF in Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Email, otherwise every sign-up tries to send a (fake) confirmation email.
auth.confirmEmail: Email confirmation is still ON. Turn it off in Supabase → Authentication → Providers → Email to enable username sign-up.
auth.signupDisabled: Sign-ups are disabled in Supabase. Enable them: Authentication → Providers → Email → turn ON "Enable sign up" (and keep "Confirm email" OFF).
auth.privacyNote: Your progress and achievements stay on this device. Signing in adds your race results to the leaderboard.

race.title: Multiplayer Race
race.subtitle: Type the same text as other players in real time — first one to finish wins.

race.guestNote: Playing as a guest is fine — results still go to the leaderboard.

race.roomsEmpty: No open rooms right now — create one or quick-match.
race.roomsMissing: The room list isn't available yet — run supabase/schema.sql (adds the rooms table) in your Supabase SQL editor.
